subtitle_zh: 漫步在史凯威的街道上，仿佛回到了十九世纪的淘金时代。
subtitle_en: Walking through Skagway feels like stepping back into the 19th-century Gold Rush.

subtitle_zh: 这里保留了大量历史建筑，木造外墙和复古招牌充满西部风情。
subtitle_en: Historic buildings, wooden facades, and vintage signs give it a western feeling.

subtitle_zh: 这也让史凯威成为阿拉斯加最有特色的小镇之一。
subtitle_en: This makes Skagway one of Alaska's most distinctive towns.

subtitle_zh: 这里就是白隘口铁路的历史车站。
subtitle_en: This is the historic depot of the White Pass railway.

subtitle_zh: 每天都有来自邮轮的游客在这里集合搭车。
subtitle_en: Every day, cruise passengers gather here to board the train.

subtitle_zh: 车站已有一百多年历史，见证了淘金热时期无数人的梦想。
subtitle_en: The station has over a century of history and witnessed many Gold Rush dreams.

subtitle_zh: 走进车站内部，可以看到关于铁路历史的展示。
subtitle_en: Inside the station, there are exhibits about the railway's history.

subtitle_zh: 包括模型火车、老照片以及当年的文物。
subtitle_en: They include model trains, old photos, and historic artifacts.

subtitle_zh: 虽然规模不大，却让人更了解这条铁路如何改变整个地区的发展。
subtitle_en: It is small, but it helps explain how this railway changed the region.

subtitle_zh: 这是史凯威规模最大的礼品店之一，Glacier Bay Trading Company。
subtitle_en: This is Glacier Bay Trading Company, one of Skagway's largest gift shops.

subtitle_zh: 从阿拉斯加特色服饰、鲑鱼制品，到各式纪念品，都可以在这里找到。
subtitle_en: From Alaska clothing and salmon products to souvenirs, you can find them here.

subtitle_zh: 如果想带点伴手礼回家，这里是不错的选择。
subtitle_en: It is a good place to buy gifts to take home.

subtitle_zh: Broadway 是史凯威最热闹的主要街道。
subtitle_en: Broadway is Skagway's busiest main street.

subtitle_zh: 街道两旁都是十九世纪风格建筑，商店、餐厅、珠宝店和纪念品店林立。
subtitle_en: Both sides are lined with shops, restaurants, jewelry stores, and souvenir shops.

subtitle_zh: 天气好的时候，慢慢散步就是最舒服的旅行方式。
subtitle_en: On a nice day, walking slowly is the best way to enjoy it.

subtitle_zh: 在树林旁，我发现了一块特别的彩绘石头。
subtitle_en: Near the trees, I found a special painted stone.

subtitle_zh: 上面写着：回到家乡时，我一定会告诉大家，史凯威真的太棒了。
subtitle_en: It says: When I return home, I will tell everyone that Skagway is wonderful.

subtitle_zh: 虽然只是一块普通的石头，却充满了旅人对这里的美好回忆。
subtitle_en: It is just a simple stone, but it carries a traveler's warm memory.

subtitle_zh: 史凯威虽然只是邮轮航线上的一个小镇，却融合了自然风光、淘金历史和人文特色。
subtitle_en: Skagway may be small, but it blends scenery, Gold Rush history, and local character.

subtitle_zh: 从百年铁路到海鲜美食，从历史建筑到悠闲街道，每个角落都值得探索。
subtitle_en: From old railways and seafood to historic streets, every corner is worth exploring.

subtitle_zh: 如果有机会来到阿拉斯加，我非常推荐在这里安排一整天。
subtitle_en: If you visit Alaska, I highly recommend spending a full day here.

subtitle_zh: 希望大家喜欢今天的分享，我们下一个目的地再见！
subtitle_en: I hope you enjoyed today's video. See you at the next destination!
